stops.name: Grindelwald
stops.detail: The Eiger rises directly southwest of Grindelwald (district of Interlaken).

stops.name: Mittellegigrat
stops.detail: It forms the basis for the sharp Mittellegigrat ridge, which stretches from the Lower Grindelwald Glacier to the summit.

days.title: High Alpine Dreigestirn Peaks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Eiger
stops.detail: The Eiger is a mountain in the Bernese Alps with a height of 3967 m above sea level.

stops.name: Mönch
stops.detail: Together with the Mönch and the Jungfrau, whose peaks lie on the border of the canton of Valais, the Eiger dominates the landscape of the central Bernese Oberland.

stops.name: Jungfrau
stops.detail: Together with the Mönch and the Jungfrau (4158 m above sea level), the Eiger forms the "Dreigestirn" (triumvirate), in which the Eiger forms the northeastern and the Jungfrau the southwestern end point.
